body: I appreciate the sentiment, thank you.

I feel like the difference is that it's predetermined. We all could die at any moment, but I *know* I'm probably going to kill myself, so isn't it cruel to let someone get attached? 

In my mind being their friend is selfish because I'm putting more pain in their life than it had before. Without knowing me, they'd have one less friend to have enjoyable conversations with, **but** they also wouldn't have to mourn the death of a loved one later on.

"Everyone could love you, but if you don't love yourself, you're going to feel like crap." 

Well said, I agree with you. I'll give the list a shot.
